label: Arc Jeans Pocket
description: The arc jeans pocket is the slash-style five-pocket opening. The mouth drops from the waistband at the side, turns, and sweeps inboard across the front of the leg on a very shallow fall, then bends distinctly downward over its last stretch to meet the pressed front crease in a hooked corner. That terminal downward hook is what separates it from the squared version, whose run ends flat. The long inboard sweep gives easy hand access and keeps the casual denim character. It is the most common front pocket on modern jeans and casual cotton trousers.
